name: Climate Impact Estimator
objective: Translate integrated climate-water risk into transparent screening-level impact and resource-pressure indicators.
resource_pressure_formula: Resource Pressure Index = 0.60 × Water Stress + 0.40 × Climate Risk
climate_exposure_formula: Climate Exposure Index = 0.70 × Climate Risk + 0.30 × High Integrated Risk Flag × 100
climate_water_compounding_formula: Compounding Index = sqrt(Climate Risk × Water Stress)
monitoring_pressure_formula: Monitoring Pressure = 0.50 × Integrated Risk + 0.25 × Resource Pressure + 0.25 × Climate Exposure
validation_status: screening framework; field impact validation not performed
